search_products.title: Search Walmart products
search_products.description: Search Walmart for products by keyword, optionally within a search category, filtered by price, rating, condition, delivery type or facets and sorted. Returns search_results (item id, title, price, rating, seller), facets and pagination. Use get_product for one item's full details.
search_products.notes: Each call spends one BlueCart request credit (more with max_page).

search_term.description: What to search Walmart for, e.g. 'highlighter pens'. Required unless category_id or url is given.

category_id.description: Search Category ID (Walmart's cat_id) to limit the search to; not the same ids as list_categories returns.

rating.description: Only products with this star rating band (four_star means 4-5 stars).

page.description: Page of results to fetch (see pagination in the response).

max_page.description: Fetch pages page..max_page in one call and concatenate them (up to 5 in real time); each page costs one credit.

facets.description: Filter facets as name=value pairs, comma-separated, e.g. brand=Garmin,screen_size=6" (facet names come from a previous response).

url.description: A full Walmart search-results URL to fetch instead; overrides every other parameter.

walmart_domain.description: Walmart site to query (default walmart.com). walmart.ca supports only search and product requests.

store_id.description: Walmart store id to localise prices and availability (required for product requests on walmart.ca). Cannot be combined with customer_zipcode.

customer_zipcode.description: Zipcode to localise results to; must first be added with add_zipcodes. Cannot be combined with store_id.

output.description: Response format: json (default), html (raw page) or csv.

csv_fields.description: With output=csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include, e.g. search_results.product.title.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to keep, e.g. pagination,search_results.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to drop.

search_results.description: Products with product.item_id, title, link, price offers and ratings.

get_category_products.title: List a category's products
get_category_products.description: List the products in a Walmart category (walmart.com only), with the same sorting and filters as search_products. Get category ids from list_categories. Returns category_results, facets and pagination.
get_category_products.notes: Each call spends one BlueCart request credit (more with max_page).

category_id.description: Category id to list, preferably one returned by list_categories.

rating.description: Only products with this star rating band (four_star means 4-5 stars).

page.description: Page of results to fetch (see pagination in the response).

max_page.description: Fetch pages page..max_page in one call and concatenate them (up to 5 in real time); each page costs one credit.

facets.description: Filter facets as name=value pairs, comma-separated, e.g. brand=Garmin,screen_size=6" (facet names come from a previous response).

url.description: A full Walmart category page URL to fetch instead; overrides every other parameter.

store_id.description: Walmart store id to localise prices and availability (required for product requests on walmart.ca). Cannot be combined with customer_zipcode.

customer_zipcode.description: Zipcode to localise results to; must first be added with add_zipcodes. Cannot be combined with store_id.

output.description: Response format: json (default), html (raw page) or csv.

csv_fields.description: With output=csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include, e.g. search_results.product.title.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to keep, e.g. pagination,search_results.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to drop.

get_product.title: Get a Walmart product
get_product.description: Fetch a Walmart product page by item id, GTIN/UPC/ISBN or URL: title, brand, price and buy-box offer, availability, images, specifications, variants, ratings and seller. Supply one of item_id, gtin or url. Use get_product_reviews for the review text.
get_product.notes: Each call spends one BlueCart request credit (more with max_page).

gtin.description: GTIN, UPC or ISBN to look up instead of item_id; the first matching Walmart item is returned.

url.description: Full Walmart product page URL; overrides item_id and gtin.

include_html.description: Also return the raw page HTML (large).

walmart_domain.description: Walmart site to query (default walmart.com). walmart.ca supports only search and product requests.

store_id.description: Walmart store id to localise prices and availability (required for product requests on walmart.ca). Cannot be combined with customer_zipcode.

customer_zipcode.description: Zipcode to localise results to; must first be added with add_zipcodes. Cannot be combined with store_id.

output.description: Response format: json (default), html (raw page) or csv.

csv_fields.description: With output=csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include, e.g. search_results.product.title.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to keep, e.g. pagination,search_results.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to drop.

product.description: Product details: item_id, title, brand, buybox_winner (price, seller, availability), images, specifications, variants, rating.

location_info.description: Store or zipcode the data was localised to.

get_product_reviews.title: Get product reviews
get_product_reviews.description: Fetch customer reviews of a Walmart product (walmart.com only): each review's rating, title, text, date and helpful votes, plus the rating summary, top positive/negative reviews and pagination. Supply item_id or url.
get_product_reviews.notes: Each call spends one BlueCart request credit (more with max_page).

item_id.description: Walmart item id whose reviews to fetch.

url.description: Walmart reviews-page URL, used when item_id is absent.

max_page.description: Fetch pages page..max_page in one call (up to 5); each page costs one credit.

output.description: Response format: json (default), html (raw page) or csv.

csv_fields.description: With output=csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include, e.g. search_results.product.title.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to keep, e.g. pagination,search_results.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to drop.

reviews.description: Reviews with rating, title, body, date and helpful votes.

get_seller_profile.title: Get a seller profile
get_seller_profile.description: Fetch a Walmart marketplace seller's profile (walmart.com only): name, rating, review count, contact details and policies. Supply seller_id or url; seller ids appear in product offers.
get_seller_profile.notes: Each call spends one BlueCart request credit (more with max_page).

url.description: Walmart seller profile URL, used when seller_id is absent.

output.description: Response format: json (default), html (raw page) or csv.

csv_fields.description: With output=csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include, e.g. search_results.product.title.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to keep, e.g. pagination,search_results.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to drop.

get_autocomplete_suggestions.title: Get search suggestions
get_autocomplete_suggestions.description: Return the search suggestions Walmart's search box offers for partial text (walmart.com only), useful for keyword research before search_products.
get_autocomplete_suggestions.notes: Each call spends one BlueCart request credit (more with max_page).

search_term.description: Partial search text to complete, e.g. 'memory'.

output.description: Response format: json (default), html (raw page) or csv.

csv_fields.description: With output=csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include, e.g. search_results.product.title.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to keep, e.g. pagination,search_results.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation JSON fields to drop.

list_categories.title: List categories
list_categories.description: Browse Walmart's category tree for ids to pass to get_category_products. With no arguments returns the root categories; with parent_id its children; with search_term matching categories anywhere; with id one category. Use only one of id, parent_id or search_term. Free of charge.

parent_id.description: Return the children of this category.

search_term.description: Return categories whose name contains this text, e.g. appliances.

categories.description: Categories with id, name, has_children, is_root and path.

category.description: The requested category, when id is given.

current_category.description: The parent category, when parent_id is given.

check_connection.title: Check the connection
check_connection.description: List Walmart's root categories, the connector's own verification call. Free, and the cheapest request that proves the API key works; use list_categories to browse the tree or get_account for usage.

get_account.title: Get account usage
get_account.description: Read the account's plan, credits used, limit and remaining this month, reset date, destination and zipcode usage, usage history and current platform status. Free of charge.

list_error_logs.title: List error logs
list_error_logs.description: List recent failed real-time requests (HTTP 500s) from the last 3 days with the Walmart URL tried, the parameters used, how often it failed and the response, to tell a bad request from a Walmart outage. 10 per page; free but limited to 60 calls a minute.

search_term.description: Only logs whose parameters contain this text.

logs.description: Logs with id, engine_url, api_url, date, count, parameters and result.

list_zipcodes.title: List zipcodes
list_zipcodes.description: List the zipcodes configured on the account (usable as customer_zipcode) with their status (preparing or available) and the plan's zipcode usage. 10 per page.

domain.description: Only zipcodes for this Walmart domain.

zipcodes.description: Map of domain to zipcode entries.

add_zipcodes.title: Add zipcodes
add_zipcodes.description: Add zipcodes to the account so requests can be localised with customer_zipcode. New zipcodes take about 2 minutes to become available; the plan limits how many you can hold.

zipcodes.description: Zip or postal codes to add, e.g. ["72712"].

domain.description: Walmart domain the zipcodes are for.

output.description: The add result with updated usage.

delete_zipcodes.title: Delete zipcodes
delete_zipcodes.description: Remove zipcodes from the account. Any request or collection request still using one of them in customer_zipcode will fail afterwards.

zipcodes.description: Zip or postal codes to remove.

domain.description: Walmart domain the zipcodes are on.

output.description: The delete result with updated usage.

list_collections.title: List collections
list_collections.description: List the account's collections (scheduled batches of up to 15,000 requests) with status, schedule and request counts, filtered by name, status, dates or destination. Limited to 60 calls a minute.

search_term.description: Only collections whose name matches this text.

status.description: Only collections in this state (default all).

only_with_results.description: Only collections that have result sets.

only_without_results.description: Only collections that have never produced a result set.

created_before.description: Created before this ISO 8601 UTC time.

created_after.description: Created after this ISO 8601 UTC time.

last_run_before.description: Last run before this ISO 8601 UTC time.

last_run_after.description: Last run after this ISO 8601 UTC time.

destination_id.description: Only collections uploading to this destination.

collections.description: Collections with id, name, status, schedule and request counts.

get_collection.title: Get a collection
get_collection.description: Read one collection: schedule, status (idle/queued/running), request count and pages, credits required and result set count. Use list_collection_requests or list_result_sets for the contents.

create_collection.title: Create a collection
create_collection.description: Create a collection that runs a batch of Walmart requests on a schedule (or manually) and delivers result sets by email, webhook or storage destination. Add requests with add_collection_requests afterwards.

enabled.description: Whether the collection runs on its schedule.

schedule_type.description: When it runs: monthly, weekly, daily, minutes (every N minutes) or manual (only via start_collection).

schedule_days_of_month.description: Days of the month to run (monthly or minutes schedules), e.g. [1,20].

schedule_days_of_week.description: Days of the week to run, 0=Sunday..6=Saturday (weekly or minutes schedules).

schedule_hours.description: Hours of the day to run, 0-23 in the account timezone, e.g. [9,17].

priority.description: Queue priority relative to other collections.

destination_ids.description: Destination ids (list_destinations) to upload result sets to.

notification_email.description: Email address told when a result set is ready.

notification_webhook.description: URL that receives a POST when a result set is ready.

notification_csv_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation fields for CSV results.

requests_type.description: Lock the collection to one request type, or mixed.

output.description: The created collection, with its id.

update_collection.title: Update a collection
update_collection.description: Change a collection's name, schedule, priority, notifications, destinations or request-type lock. Only allowed while it is not running.

enabled.description: Whether the collection runs on its schedule.

schedule_type.description: When it runs: monthly, weekly, daily, minutes (every N minutes) or manual (only via start_collection).

schedule_days_of_month.description: Days of the month to run (monthly or minutes schedules), e.g. [1,20].

schedule_days_of_week.description: Days of the week to run, 0=Sunday..6=Saturday (weekly or minutes schedules).

schedule_hours.description: Hours of the day to run, 0-23 in the account timezone, e.g. [9,17].

priority.description: Queue priority relative to other collections.

destination_ids.description: Destination ids (list_destinations) to upload result sets to.

notification_email.description: Email address told when a result set is ready.

notification_webhook.description: URL that receives a POST when a result set is ready.

notification_csv_fields.description: Comma-separated dot-notation fields for CSV results.

requests_type.description: Lock the collection to one request type, or mixed.

delete_collection.title: Delete a collection
delete_collection.description: Permanently delete a collection with its requests and result sets. Only allowed while it is not running.

start_collection.title: Start a collection
start_collection.description: Queue a collection to run now, whatever its schedule. Spends one credit per request in the collection and fails if the account lacks the credits or it is already running.
start_collection.notes: A GET by the provider's design, so it is marked read-only, but it starts a billed batch run.

output.description: Confirmation that the collection was queued.

stop_collection.title: Stop a collection
stop_collection.description: Stop a queued or running collection and return it to idle. Credits are refunded only if it had not started running yet.
stop_collection.notes: A GET by the provider's design, so it is marked read-only, but it changes the collection's state.

output.description: Confirmation that the collection was stopped.

stop_all_collections.title: Stop all collections
stop_all_collections.description: Stop every queued or running collection on the account at once. Queued runs are refunded; running ones are not.
stop_all_collections.notes: A GET by the provider's design, so it is marked read-only, but it changes every running collection's state.

output.description: Confirmation that the collections were stopped.

add_collection_requests.title: Add requests to a collection
add_collection_requests.description: Add up to 1,000 requests per call to a collection that is not running (15,000 per collection, 100 with include_html). Each request object takes the same parameters as the real-time tools plus type, e.g. {"type": "product", "item_id": "782866746", "customer_zipcode": "77001", "custom_id": "sku-1"}.

requests.description: Request objects: type (search, category, product, reviews, seller_profile, autocomplete) plus that type's parameters, optionally custom_id to track it.

output.description: The collection with its updated request count.

list_collection_requests.title: List a collection's requests
list_collection_requests.description: List the requests in a collection, 1,000 per page, optionally searching their parameters (q) or custom_id. Page count is requests_page_count from get_collection.

q.description: Only requests whose parameters or custom_id contain this text.

requests.description: Requests with id, custom_id and parameters.

get_collection_requests_download_links.title: Get request download links
get_collection_requests_download_links.description: Get download links for every request in a collection as JSON or CSV files, one file per 1,000-request page. Useful for exporting a large collection.

update_collection_request.title: Update a collection request
update_collection_request.description: Change the parameters of one request in a collection that is not running. Pass only the parameters to change.

parameters.description: Request parameters to change, e.g. {"item_id": "19599042"} or {"custom_id": "sku-2"}.

delete_collection_request.title: Delete a collection request
delete_collection_request.description: Remove one request from a collection that is not running. For many at once use delete_collection_requests.

delete_collection_requests.title: Delete several collection requests
delete_collection_requests.description: Remove a list of requests from a collection that is not running in one call. To empty the whole collection use clear_collection_requests.

clear_collection_requests.title: Clear a collection's requests
clear_collection_requests.description: Delete every request in a collection (which must not be running), keeping the collection and its settings.

output.description: Confirmation that the collection was cleared.

list_result_sets.title: List result sets
list_result_sets.description: List a collection's result sets (one per run, kept 14 days), newest first, with run times and request success counts.

results.description: Result sets with id, started_at, ended_at, requests_completed and requests_failed.

get_result_set.title: Get a result set
get_result_set.description: Get one result set's details and download links for its JSON result pages. Use get_result_set_in_format for JSON Lines or CSV files.

get_result_set_in_format.title: Get a result set as JSON Lines or CSV
get_result_set_in_format.description: Get download links for a result set's files in JSON Lines or CSV format; for CSV choose the columns with csv_fields.

csv_fields.description: With csv, comma-separated dot-notation fields to include.

output.description: The result set with download links.

resend_result_set_webhook.title: Resend a result set webhook
resend_result_set_webhook.description: Re-send the completion webhook POST for a result set, for debugging a webhook receiver without re-running the collection.
resend_result_set_webhook.notes: A GET by the provider's design; it triggers an outbound webhook POST.

output.description: Confirmation that the webhook was sent.

list_destinations.title: List destinations
list_destinations.description: List the cloud storage destinations (S3, GCS, Azure, OSS, S3-compatible) that collection result sets can be uploaded to, with usage against the 50-destination limit. 10 per page.

search_term.description: Only destinations whose name contains this text.

destinations.description: Destinations with id, name, type and enabled.

create_destination.title: Create a destination
create_destination.description: Add a cloud storage bucket that collection result sets are uploaded to. Supply the credential fields for the chosen type; BlueCart writes and deletes a test file to verify access and fails if it cannot.

enabled.description: Whether result sets are uploaded to it.

s3_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the bucket; %COLLECTION_ID%, %COLLECTION_NAME%, %RESULT_SET_ID% and %DATE% are replaced.

gcs_access_key.description: Google Cloud Storage interoperable access key (gcs).

gcs_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the GCS bucket.

azure_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the Azure container.

oss_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the OSS bucket.

output.description: The created destination, with its id.

update_destination.title: Update a destination
update_destination.description: Change a destination's name, enabled flag, credentials, bucket or path prefix. New credentials or re-enabling trigger a connectivity test.

enabled.description: Whether result sets are uploaded to it.

s3_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the bucket; %COLLECTION_ID%, %COLLECTION_NAME%, %RESULT_SET_ID% and %DATE% are replaced.

gcs_access_key.description: Google Cloud Storage interoperable access key (gcs).

gcs_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the GCS bucket.

azure_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the Azure container.

oss_path_prefix.description: Path prefix in the OSS bucket.

delete_destination.title: Delete a destination
delete_destination.description: Remove a storage destination; collections using it stop uploading there. Files already uploaded are untouched.
